headline: Sensex and Nifty Plunge Over 1,000 Points to Multi-Month Lows Amid Surging Oil Prices and IT Sector Woes

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surging crude oil prices impacting market sentiment
Massive exodus of foreign funds from the Indian market
Suspension of major IT firms from the US Labour Certification Programme
Global cues and concerns over a 32-month low in the Sensex
whatHappening: Sensex crashed over 1,000 points, hitting its lowest level in 32 months
Nifty dropped below the 22,250 mark, touching a fresh 52-week low
Approximately ₹7 lakh crore of investor wealth was eroded in a single session
Major IT companies like Infosys and Wipro saw their ADRs fall following US immigration program suspensions
summary: The Indian stock market experienced a massive sell-off on Thursday, with the Sensex and Nifty plunging over 1,000 points due to rising crude prices and foreign fund outflows. The IT sector faced significant pressure after giants like TCS, Infosys, and Wipro were suspended from a US labor certification program. Total investor wealth saw a staggering erosion of ₹7 lakh crore as the Nifty hit a new 52-week low.
